_comment: Single source of truth for the diagram_type frontmatter enum. Edit this file to add, rename, or document diagram types. check_doc_frontmatter.py reads this file at startup; architect-review.md is regenerated by build.py when this file changes. No {paths.*} placeholders needed — diagram types do not declare default_path fields.

data_flow.description: Shows how data moves between system components (canonical new value, replaces 'dataflow').

dataflow.description: Legacy alias for data_flow. Use data_flow in new diagrams.

user_flow.description: Shows user interactions with surfaces (dashboards, API); requires related_surfaces.

agent_flow.description: Shows agent invocation / orchestration flows (supervisor -> sub-agent dispatch, handoff, escalation) between Claude Code agents; requires related_agents.

sequence.description: Shows time-ordered message exchanges between actors.

container.description: Shows deployment containers and their relationships (C4 Container level).

context.description: Shows system boundaries and external actors (C4 Context level).

state.description: Shows state machine transitions for a component or workflow.

component.description: Shows internal structure of a container (C4 Component level).

none.description: Placeholder for docs that declare no diagram type.
